sloka: नार्जुनः खेदमायाति न राक्षसगणेश्वरः ।इदमासीत्तयोर्युद्धं यथा पूर्वं बलीन्द्रयोः ।। ७.३२.५८ ॥
transliteration: nārjunaḥ khedamāyāti na rākṣasagaṇeśvaraḥ ।idamāsīttayoryuddhaṁ yathā pūrvaṁ balīndrayoḥ ।। 7.32.58 ॥

translations.english: Neither Arjuna nor the lord of the demon hosts (Ravana) showed any weariness, and their battle was like the ancient conflict between Bali and Indra.
